checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Same face, hair, shirt and kitchen across all frames.

must.item: Audible coherent agent-written English line inviting viewers to the sale
must.why: Audio has sound at -0.5 dB, but the words were not transcribed. The script in the chat is suitable.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product or offer
must.why: The stated script has none, but the spoken audio could not be verified.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech
must.why: The mouth is open to different degrees across frames, consistent with speaking. Exact sync can't be verified without audio.

must.item: One square 8s video, friendly male voice, no captions
must.why: The frames are square, 8s, with no captions. The voice can't be judged by ear, but the video itself is fine.

faults.what: The mouth opens quite wide and the head moves a lot in frame 4, which looks a bit exaggerated. This is a mild artefact.

summary: The result is a clean square talking video of the same grey-haired man, with natural mouth movement and no captions; the voice and words could not be checked by ear.
